service.name: dev.avyos.distro
service.description: Distribution image management API with pull/run/shell lifecycle operations.

types.name: Empty
types.description: Empty payload used for requests and responses without data.

types.name: ListRequest
types.description: Filter for listing available and installed distros.

types.name: PullRequest
types.description: Payload for pulling a distro image by name and source URL.

types.name: RunRequest
types.description: Execution payload for running a command inside a distro context.

types.name: RunResult
types.description: Execution output for a distro command run.

types.name: RemoveRequest
types.description: Payload for removing an installed distro image.

types.name: ShellOpenRequest
types.description: Payload to open an interactive shell session in a distro.

types.name: ShellSession
types.description: Shell session identifier assigned by the service.

types.name: ShellInputRequest
types.description: Input payload for an open shell session.

types.name: ShellResizeRequest
types.description: Resize payload for a shell pseudo-terminal.

types.name: ShellCloseRequest
types.description: Request to close an active shell session.

types.name: ShellOutputEvent
types.description: Streamed terminal output for an active shell session.

types.name: ShellExitEvent
types.description: Exit notification for a shell session.

requests.name: List
requests.description: List installed or available distro images.

requests.name: Pull
requests.description: Pull and install a distro image.
requests.request_description: Contains distro name and optional source URL.

requests.name: Run
requests.description: Run a non-interactive command in a distro environment.
requests.response_description: Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

requests.name: ShellOpen
requests.description: Open an interactive shell session inside a distro.
requests.request_description: Initial shell context and terminal size.
requests.response_description: Returns the created shell session id.

requests.name: ShellInput
requests.description: Send user input to an active shell session.

requests.name: ShellResize
requests.description: Resize the pseudo-terminal for an active shell session.
requests.request_description: Session id and new row/column dimensions.

events.name: ShellOutput
events.description: Published when shell output data is available.
events.request_description: Contains session id and output bytes.

events.name: ShellExit
events.description: Published when a shell session exits.
events.request_description: Contains session id and exit code.
